_doc: Corrow by day, before the storm, in the kit's frame (ADR 0200): gulls work the seawall and stand on the Watchers' heads on its sea parapet (top y 15.4; none on the Breach's stretch, x -36 to -24, so none is left on air when the wall falls); shore crabs on the mole pier (top 1.2; the wall's apron is too narrow and sea-washed for them, the sea at 0.5). The storm states (ch08_beacon_opened onward) keep them: gulls over a seawall in a rising storm are true to the coast. Re-seated on the dressed kit (the Act I audit, 2026-10-29: tools/creatures/wildlife_snap.gd and wildlife_audit.gd, which ray against the zone's visible meshes). Fish: shoals in the sea off the mole and under the wall (the sea at 0.5, deep from z 17).
